meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器，执行打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取数据等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要让 Claude 帮你操作网页，比如填写表单、截图、测试网站或提取信息时触发。

say.note: Claude 会打开网页并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我填写登录表单并提交。
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框并填写。

say.text: 比较当前页面和之前页面的差异。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate browser interactions: open URLs, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need Claude to interact with web pages, such as filling forms, taking screenshots, testing websites, or extracting information.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a screenshot.
say_en.note: Claude will open the page and save a screenshot.

say_en.text: Fill in the login form and submit it.
say_en.note: Claude will locate inputs and fill them.

say_en.text: Compare the current page with the previous one.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a snapshot diff.
